spacing.observation: Desktop uses a horizontal grid of thumbnails. Mobile stacks the form, cards and impact list within the dialog and uses vertical scroll to reach lower sections.

controls.observation: Create Scene from baseline uses source/version fields and every existing card offers named Open and duplication actions. Impact rows provide per-Scene update controls.

contrast.observation: Light text and focus borders read on the dark blue modal, with the active scene and status copy distinct from the blurred workspace.

consistency.observation: The separate Environment editor preserves the blue workstation and room framing. The same manager layout resumes after an owned Bedroom copy is saved as The Haunted Bedroom.

states.observation: The current Linux cohorts save The Haunted Bedroom, create Ordinary Room, The Haunting and The Hidden Letter, duplicate and rename The Letter Study, compare the independent Scenes, and return to Studio. Environment v2 shows Ordinary Room CURRENT while the other three remain REVIEW REQUIRED.

responsive.observation: Portrait layout preserves inline edit and named selectors without a width overflow. Detail and compare actions appear in sequential sections below the Scene cards.

keyboard.observation: Recorded focus moves through modal fields and impact/compare actions, reaches Close, and the narrow recording returns to the workspace with focus on Manage Scenes.

focus.observation: Close first receives a visible outline. Review Environment impact and named version fields also render visible focus inside the scrollable modal.

feedback.observation: Create and rename show immediate named status banners. The impact list visibly changes one row to CURRENT while the others remain REVIEW REQUIRED. Feedback boundaries range 1456.51ms to 1829.95ms.

motion.observation: Normal and reduced both traverse modal, separate editor, impact and return. Reduced keeps the layout and notices while switching between surfaces without the same visible entrance fade in sampled frames.

continuity.observation: Ordinary Room becomes the active scene and reflects Environment version 2; The Letter Study, Hidden Letter and Haunting remain separate upcoming review rows.

complexity.observation: The modal is dense because it contains create, cards, revision impact and compare. The reports’ grouped repeated controls keep specific Scene actions identifiable.

role-outcomes.observation: The Creator can produce three named working Scenes with distinct thumbnails, make and rename an independent copy, and revalidate only Ordinary Room against shared Environment v2 while the other Scenes await review.

fallbacks.observation: The older 7a8bd409fe mobile capture stalled with Retry Environment catalog. Both current phone cohorts move from the owned environment through the three working Scenes, comparison and Studio return without the retry interruption.

composition.observation: The bounded blue publishing dialog keeps formal review distinct from the blurred editor. On portrait, its fixed footer leaves a scrolling content body with the Profile prerequisite visible above it.

hierarchy.observation: The five-step progress list leads into current content, with saved source and revision before decisions. Sharing and rights and Server-verified package then show clearly distinct headings.

typography.observation: The phone step tracker wraps and the Review before submitting heading receives an outline in the server-verified package. In Sharing & rights, the Linux select cuts off the end of attribution before the chevron. Explanation and final package retain the full rights meaning.

spacing.observation: The wide state centers the dialog with equal padding. Mobile steps wrap into three rows, and the content body scrolls above the fixed row of Back, step count and action.

controls.observation: The prerequisite is coupled to a visible underlined Set up public Profile destination and unavailable Continue. License and ownership confirmation precede Review package, and final submission is its own action.

contrast.observation: Cyan step circles and focus outlines distinguish the active steps. Gold notices for privacy and approval remain readable against the blue dialog, and enabled Continue is markedly brighter than the prerequisite state.

consistency.observation: Saved source is opened through contextual Library details and maintains the Studio palette; prerequisite setup uses the recognizable teal Homeport Profile composition.

states.observation: The current reduced-motion flow shows the saved source, profile gate and ready outcome, included content, rights, server-verified package review, and return to Studio at both widths.

responsive.observation: The mobile dialog keeps the actionable link visible at initial gate and supports scrolling through rights. The native license string is clipped at its final edge in portrait, with the full policy explained underneath.

keyboard.observation: Recordings show navigation among Library tabs, outline on Continue and keyboard rights confirmation. The progression remains focusable inside the dialog instead of handing the keyboard back to the workspace.

focus.observation: Close is ringed at initial open, and Review before submitting moves focus to the package heading. On dialog close, the Library trigger takes a visible outline before navigation back to Studio.

feedback.observation: Profile gate language explains why the source remains private, while Server-verified package gives a distinct second-phase result. The plan defines no separate numeric feedback budget for this reduced-only capture.

motion.observation: Both recordings run reduced motion, with direct dialog, profile, returned draft and package transitions. They show the preview opening and closing without requiring motion to understand the change.

continuity.observation: The selected synthetic Scene and revision 3 recur after public Profile save and contextual Library reinspection. The captured fixture has no pinned Environment, so it offers a spatial asset export and exercises no version choice.

complexity.observation: The wizard defers metadata beyond Content and makes the rights gate explicit before package assembly. The final step keeps Submit separate from authoritative package review.

role-outcomes.observation: The Creator opens a server-verified preview while the Library still identifies the saved source as private. The desktop preview exposes the named source, Desk Map, classification as Spatial asset and moderation notice. Closing the preview restores the Library, and the route returns to Studio without crossing the separate submission step.

fallbacks.observation: The Profile gate keeps Continue disabled and gives a direct setup link. Returning to the working draft and re-opening the same Library item removes the gate and preserves the named source.

findings.observation: At 390px the Sharing and rights select cuts off the end of Noncommercial remix with attribution against the chevron. The panel immediately below spells out permitted credited remixes, the commercial-use restriction and attribution, and the next package review displays the full license. The narrow selector issue was also recorded in the earlier review.
